## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this solve? Why is this feature needed?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Implementation Notes
(Optional) Technical details or suggestions for implementation.

## Could This Be a MOD Instead?
Could this be implemented as a MOD rather than core MOD Loader functionality?
- [ ] Yes, but it would be better in core because...
- [ ] No, it requires core changes because...

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues and discussions
- [ ] I have considered if this should be a MOD
- [ ] I have described the problem, not just the solution
